english: If I were you, I would take the job.
chinese: 如果我是你，我会接受这份工作。
soundmark: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː aɪ wʊd teɪk ðə dʒɒb/

english: I wish I could fly like a bird.
chinese: 我希望我能像鸟一样飞。
soundmark: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd flaɪ laɪk ə bɜːrd/

english: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
chinese: 要是我当初更努力，我就通过考试了。
soundmark: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid ˈhɑːrdər aɪ wʊd hæv pɑːst ðə ɪɡˈzæm/

grammar.label: 虚拟语气(过去)
grammar.text: had+过去分词,would have+过去分词

english: It is necessary that he attend the meeting.
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ˈnesəsəri ðæt hiː əˈtend ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

english: I suggest that we leave early.
If only I had more time!
chinese: 要是我有更多时间就好了！

english: He ordered that everyone remain silent.
chinese: 他命令所有人都保持安静。

english: Without water, there would be no life.
soundmark: /wɪˈðaʊt ˈwɔːtər ðeər wʊd biː nəʊ laɪf/

english: I would rather you stayed here.
It's high time that we took action.
chinese: 是时候我们采取行动了。
soundmark: /ɪts haɪ taɪm ðæt wiː tʊk ˈækʃn/

english: If it were to snow tomorrow, what would you do?
chinese: 如果明天下雪，你会做什么？
soundmark: /ɪf ɪt wɜːr tuː snəʊ təˈmɒrəʊ wɒt wʊd juː duː/

english: She treats me as if I were a stranger.
chinese: 她对我就像对待陌生人一样。
soundmark: /ʃiː triːts miː æz ɪf aɪ wɜːr ə ˈstreɪndʒər/

english: Had I known earlier, I would have helped you.
chinese: 要是我早知道，我就帮你了。
soundmark: /hæd aɪ nəʊn ˈɜːrliər aɪ wʊd hæv helpt juː/

english: It is strange that he should say that.
chinese: 真奇怪他竟然会说那种话。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz streɪndʒ ðæt hiː ʃʊd seɪ ðæt/

english: I wish I had followed your advice then.
chinese: 我真希望当时听了你的建议。
soundmark: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈfɒləʊd jɔːr ədˈvaɪs ðen/
